data.name: Aktham
data.gender_notes: Aktham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aktham means merciful and kind-hearted, reflecting the qualities of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name Aktham carries the meaning “Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aktham usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aktham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Merciful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aktham total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أكثم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الإكثار من الخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: أكثم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من فعل 'أكثم' الذي يعني الإكثار من الخير والجود. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرغوبة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يعبر عن السخاء والكرم. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يزيد من قدسية هذا الاسم وروعته.

in_urdu.name: اکثم
in_urdu.meaning: اکثم کا مطلب ہے خیر کی کثرت، سخاوت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکثم ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خیر کی کثرت، سخاوت اور کریم النفسیں۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان خوبیوں کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جن کی مسلمانان قدر کرتے ہیں، جیسے کہ سخاوت، عطا کرنے اور اچھائی کا بستر بستر کرنا۔

in_hindi.name: अक्थम
in_hindi.meaning: अक्थम का अर्थ है अधिक से अधिक अच्छा करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक्थम एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है अधिक से अधिक अच्छा करना, उदारता और अच्छे कार्यों की अधिकता। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जिन्हें मुसलमान महत्व देते हैं, जैसे कि उदारता, दान करना और अच्छे काम करना।

in_pashto.name: اکثم
in_pashto.long_meaning: اکثم یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د خیر کثرت، سخاوت او پرهیزګارۍ معنی ورکوي. د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړو کې، دا نوم د مثبتو ځانګړتیو لکه سخاوت، نیکۍ او د خلکو سره د مرستې د ارزښتونو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Aktham
in_english.long_meaning: Aktham is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies abundance of good, generosity, and magnanimity. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects desirable qualities such as liberality, charity, and benevolence. The name Aktham is associated with positive personality traits like kindness, compassion, and warmth. Its usage spans across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the values of goodness and charity.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: اکثم (a-ktham)

data.cultural_impact: The name Aktham carries a positive connotation in Islamic culture as it signifies kindness, compassion, and mercy. These qualities are highly valued and emphasized in the teachings of Islam. Moreover, this name can serve as a daily reminder for the person bearing the name to strive towards being a merciful and kind individual towards others. It can also inspire others to reason towards having such values in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aktham holds great significance as it encourages the bearer to embody the qualities of kindness, mercy, and compassion. This is in line with the teachings of Islam, which emphasizes compassion and mercy towards all of God's creations. The name also serves as a daily reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) merciful character and the importance of being kind to others. Ultimately, the name Aktham inspires the bearer to strive towards becoming a better servant of God by emulating the best qualities of the Prophet Muhammad.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aktham ibn Malik al-Ghifari was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aktham carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aktham was a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad and took part in several military campaigns.
